definitions.explanation: A projecting roof or overhang above a door, window, or entrance that provides shelter from rain and sun. Found on traditional and modern buildings.
The projecting front part of a cap or hat that shields the eyes from sunlight.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the architectural meaning, referring to any overhanging structure that provides shelter. Sense 2 is used for the front part of caps and hats. The proverb {庇|ひさし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貸|か}して→貸す：00537_kasu⟧{母屋|おもや}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}られる→取る：00565_toru⟧ means "lend the eaves and lose the main house" — give someone an inch and they'll take a mile.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {庇|ひさし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (under the eaves)
- ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{庇|ひさし} (entrance awning)
- ⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{庇|ひさし} (brim/visor of a hat)
